name: Acrobatic, Greater
body:
You are much more adept at your leaping and tumbling.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatic, Acrobatics 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): You are able to leap, fall, and tumble more adeptly than your peers. You increase the bonus provided by the Acrobatic feat by 2. Additionally, you treat any fall as 20 feet shorter. This stacks with other reductions to effective fall height.
